stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half the API price of the 5.6 series

key_facts.fact: On September 22, 2026, OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, extending the GPT-6 generation that began with GPT-6 Astra earlier in September.
key_facts.excerpt: Earlier this month, OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra... Now, the lab is expanding the GPT-6 generation with updated versions of the smaller Sol and Luna models.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI cut API prices for Sol and Luna by 50% versus GPT-5.6 promotional pricing, crediting more efficient caching and inference.
key_facts.excerpt: We've also made caching and inference more efficient, and we're passing the savings directly to you: 50% lower API prices for Sol and Luna compared with GPT-5.6 promotional pricing.

key_facts.fact: Sol targets complex tasks like coding; Luna targets high-volume tasks such as summarizing documents, extracting information or answering quick questions.
key_facts.excerpt: Sol is designed for complex tasks like coding, while OpenAI says Luna is more appropriate for clerical work — "high-volume tasks with a clear goal, like summarizing documents, extracting information, or answering quick questions."

key_facts.fact: OpenAI says that on its internal factuality evaluation GPT-6 Sol makes about half as many mistakes as its predecessor, reaching Astra-level reliability at much lower cost.
key_facts.excerpt: GPT-6 Sol makes about half as many mistakes as its predecessor, reaching Astra-level reliability at much lower cost.

key_facts.fact: The launch came about 90 minutes after Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5, and OpenAI claims Sol and Luna beat Anthropic's Fable and Opus models on tasks.
key_facts.excerpt: Notably, Anthropic released a new version of Opus 5.5 just 90 minutes before OpenAI's release, reflecting the intense competition between the two companies.

key_facts.fact: Both models are rolling out in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu users and in the API; Free and Go users can try GPT-6 Luna in the desktop app.
key_facts.excerpt: GPT-6 Sol and Luna roll out today in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Both are also available in the API. Free and Go users can try GPT-6 Luna in the desktop app.

key_facts.fact: On September 23, OpenAI said ChatGPT Voice can now be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna and use plugins like email, calendar and Slack.
key_facts.excerpt: ChatGPT Voice can now: Use plugins like your email, calendar, and Slack. Be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna.

stories.headline: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS, which designs voices from prompts and clones from 30 seconds

key_facts.fact: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS on September 23, 2026, calling them its most expressive audio generation models yet.
key_facts.excerpt: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet.

key_facts.fact: Flash TTS lets users create voices from scratch via natural-language prompts across more than 100 languages and dialects, and offers a library of 2,000+ production-ready voices.
key_facts.excerpt: create bespoke voices from scratch by customizing role, accent and voice characteristics across more than 100 languages and dialects... Access 2,000+ production-ready voices

key_facts.fact: The model can replicate a voice from a 30-second audio sample, backed by consent verification, SynthID watermarking and C2PA credentials.
key_facts.excerpt: Recreate consistent vocal profiles from just a 30-second audio sample... backed by built-in consent verification, SynthID watermarking, and C2PA credentials

key_facts.fact: Users must supply a verbal consent recording from the voice owner, which the system checks against the reference speaker before creating the voice.
key_facts.excerpt: Google says users must supply a verbal consent recording from the voice owner, and the system checks that it matches the reference speaker before creating the voice.

key_facts.fact: Google says the models took top positions in blind human-preference tests on Voice Arena in languages including Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Hindi and Mexican Spanish.
key_facts.excerpt: In blind human preference evaluations on Voice Arena, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS secure top positions amongst competitors in key global languages, including Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Vietnamese, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), Mexican Spanish and Hindi.

key_facts.fact: The models are available in Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook and Google Vids.
key_facts.excerpt: Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.

stories.headline: OpenAI gives Ukraine free access to its Daybreak cyber-defense program and GPT-5.6 Sol

key_facts.fact: OpenAI will share its AI cyber-defense system Daybreak for free with Ukraine's government to help protect civilian infrastructure such as hospitals and power plants.
key_facts.excerpt: The tech giant OpenAI will share its AI cyber defence system Daybreak for free with the Ukraine government to help it protect civilian infrastructure, like hospitals and power plants, from cyber-attacks.

key_facts.fact: Under the deal Ukraine gets access to OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model.
key_facts.excerpt: Under the deal, Ukraine will get access to OpenAI's advanced GPT 5.6 Sol model - a rival to Anthropic's Mythos and Fable.

key_facts.fact: The agreement was announced Wednesday (September 23) at OpenAI's New York office; OpenAI said it is pledging over $1 billion in subsidized tokens to support the initiative.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement, announced Wednesday at OpenAI's New York office... OpenAI said it is also pledging over $1 billion in subsidized tokens to support the initiative.

key_facts.fact: Ukraine plans to use the tools for incident response, threat triage, login analysis, system inventory, code analysis and vulnerability validation, per consul general Dmytro Kushneruk.
key_facts.excerpt: Dmytro Kushneruk, consul general of Ukraine in San Francisco, outlined how the tools would be used for cybersecurity automation, including functions such as incident response, threat triaging, login analysis, inventorying systems, code analysis and validating vulnerabilities.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI national security policy head Sasha Baker said the company feels urgency to strike similar deals with other governments before such tools proliferate to attackers.
key_facts.excerpt: OpenAI's national security policy head, Sasha Baker, said the company felt "urgency" to try to strike similar agreements with other governments and industries.

key_facts.fact: OpenAI is working with Ukraine's Ministry of Digital Transformation; Ukraine's CERT-UA handled nearly 6,000 cyber incidents in 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: It is working with Ukraine's Ministry of Digital Transformation... Ukraine's CERT-UA handled nearly 6,000 cyber incidents in 2025.

stories.headline: Nscale's IPO filings show ByteDance was ~75% of its 2025 sales, renting Nvidia B200s in Norway

key_facts.fact: A ByteDance subsidiary in Singapore, Spring (SG) Pte Ltd, accounted for 73% of Nscale's $33M revenue in 2025 (about $24M), but ByteDance is not named anywhere in the 192-page S-1.
key_facts.excerpt: The Chinese company accounted for 73 percent of Nscale's $33 million in revenue in 2025, but it isn't named anywhere in the 192-page S-1 filing. Only an appendix mentions its Singapore subsidiary, Spring.

key_facts.fact: Spring rented 2,304 Nvidia B200 chips at Nscale's data center in Glomfjord, Norway, under a contract signed in May 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: This contract allowed Spring to access 2,304 Nvidia B200 chips at Nscale's Glomfjord, Norway, data center.

key_facts.fact: The FT reported the arrangement was legal: US export controls bar shipping the most advanced Nvidia chips to China but do not stop Chinese firms from renting them in data centers abroad.

key_facts.fact: The contract backed a $105M Macquarie loan which, with $35M of equity, paid for the chips; Macquarie required Nscale to monitor and report 'compute anomalies or suspicious configurations' that could breach export controls.
key_facts.excerpt: Macquarie compelled Nscale to monitor how the Chinese subsidiary used the AI chips and report "compute anomalies or suspicious configurations" that might be in violation of the U.S.'s export controls.

key_facts.fact: Nscale, backed by Nvidia, is reportedly seeking a valuation of up to $35B in its US IPO; the prospectus was filed with the SEC on 18 September and leaves offering size and price blank.

stories.headline: US and Iran hold first talks at the UN; Tehran tables Hormuz roadmap and a 4-5 day deadline

key_facts.fact: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff on Tuesday (Sept 22) on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, where Tehran presented its conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi met with US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff on Tuesday during the UN General Assembly, where Tehran presented its requirements for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian state media.

key_facts.fact: Iran's road map proposes a regionwide ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of Hormuz and an end to the US blockade; talks were mediated by Qatar, Pakistan and Egypt, and Trump ruled out lifting the blockade before Iran shows goodwill.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran has proposed a regionwide ceasefire of up to 60 days, a phased reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and an end to the US blockade... Donald Trump has ruled out lifting the blockade before Iran demonstrates sufficient goodwill.

key_facts.fact: Trump said US officials met the Iranian delegation for three hours in a 'very productive' meeting, with another meeting scheduled in the near future.
key_facts.excerpt: US President Trump announced that US officials met with an Iranian delegation for three hours in a meeting that was described as productive and went well, while another meeting is scheduled in the near future.

key_facts.fact: Trump said he expects a deal with Iran right after the November midterm elections.
key_facts.excerpt: "I believe we'll make a deal right after the election, because it doesn't make sense for them not to," he said.

key_facts.fact: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei said Tehran gave the US four to five days to meet its conditions and that Hormuz will not reopen until they are accepted.
key_facts.excerpt: "We have given the Americans four to five days to comply with Iran's conditions," Rezaei said. "Until Iran's conditions are accepted, there will be no negotiations and the Strait of Hormuz will not be reopened."

key_facts.fact: Hormuz transits averaged 6.98 million barrels a day in the seven days to Sept 20, about 38% of the 18.3 million b/d pre-war baseline; Iran's crude loadings fell to zero in September from 893,000 b/d in July, per Kpler.
key_facts.excerpt: Confirmed transits through the strait averaged 6.98 million barrels a day in the seven days to Sept. 20, according to Kpler. That's about 38% of the 18.3 million barrel pre-war baseline... Its crude loadings fell to zero so far in September from 893,000 barrels a day in July

key_facts.fact: Turkish Airlines halted flights to Iran until at least March 2027 and Azerbaijan suspended Iranian airline services as a US deadline to ground Iran's fleet via sanctions took effect.
key_facts.excerpt: Azerbaijan suspended Iranian airline services and Turkish Airlines halted its flights to Iran until at least March 2027.

stories.headline: Zelensky meets Trump at the UN; Kyiv offers a mutual energy ceasefire for US envoys to take to Moscow

key_facts.fact: Zelensky met Trump for 40 minutes at UN headquarters on Sept 22, their first meeting since July, to discuss an energy ceasefire and ending the war.
key_facts.excerpt: Speaking to the media after a 40-minute meeting with Trump at UN headquarters in New York, Zelenskiy said Kyiv was ready for any format of an energy ceasefire with Moscow

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said Trump did not demand that Ukraine unilaterally halt strikes on Russian refineries; Kyiv will stop if Russia stops hitting Ukraine's electricity, heating and water systems.
key_facts.excerpt: "We are ready for energy ceasefire... If they don't want us to attack their diesel and refineries, and etc, we are ready – if they will not attack our energy system, our electricity, heating system, water supplies."

key_facts.fact: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will convey Kyiv's proposal to Moscow; Secretary of State Marco Rubio was scheduled to meet Russian FM Sergey Lavrov in New York on Wednesday.
key_facts.excerpt: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will convey Kyiv's proposal to Moscow. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is scheduled to meet Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov in New York City on Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: In his UNGA address, Trump vowed to use new authority to impose tariffs of up to 100% on the top five buyers of Russian oil and gas 'if necessary' to end the war.
key_facts.excerpt: Trump signed a major sanctions bill granting him authority to impose a 100% tariff on the top five buyers of Russian oil and gas... Trump vowed to deploy his new tariff authorities "if necessary" to bring the war to an end.

key_facts.fact: Overnight before the meeting, Russia launched 212 drones plus ballistic, cruise and anti-ship missiles; a ballistic strike on the Interpipe plant in Dnipro killed four workers, while Ukraine hit refineries in Samara and Ufa.
key_facts.excerpt: an overnight ballistic missile strike on the Interpipe industrial plant in Dnipro killed four employees... Onyx anti-ship missiles, Iskander-M/S-400/KN-23 ballistic missiles, four Kalibr cruise missiles, eight Banderol/Dan-T weapons, and 212 drones.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky later said intelligence shows Russia is preparing a new massive attack on Ukraine and that easing sanctions on Russia cannot be discussed.
key_facts.excerpt: "There's intelligence right now that Russia is preparing a new massive attack against Ukraine," Zelenskiy wrote.

stories.headline: Trump backs a US diesel export ban as prices hit a record $6.53 a gallon

key_facts.fact: Trump said on Sept 22 he has called for a ban on diesel exports: 'I've said let's not send out the diesel. We make a lot of diesel.'
key_facts.excerpt: "I've said let's not send out the diesel. We make a lot of diesel ... I've called for it. I've called for it within my people," Trump told reporters ahead of a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy.

key_facts.fact: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the administration is examining whether a full or partial ban is feasible given refining capacity; Trump said a decision would come fast 'one way or another'.
key_facts.excerpt: "We're examining whether it's feasible in terms of the overall refining capacity and whether a full or partial ban would work," Bessent said... The president said a decision would quickly be made "one way or another"

key_facts.fact: US diesel hit a record $6.53 a gallon average ($8.44 in California), almost $3 above a year earlier; diesel traded around $207 a barrel, more than $100 above crude.
key_facts.excerpt: Diesel in the U.S. has surged to a record high $6.53 per gallon, almost $3 above the level last year, according to data from AAA. In California, diesel costs $8.44 per gallon... Diesel cost around $207 a barrel Tuesday, more than $100 above the price of crude oil.

key_facts.fact: The US exported a record 1.6 million barrels per day of diesel in August per Kpler; economist Philip Verleger warned a ban could raise global diesel prices by as much as 100%.
key_facts.excerpt: US exported record 1.6 million barrels per day of diesel in August, Kpler says. Export ban could raise global diesel prices by as much as 100%, economist Verleger says

key_facts.fact: Republican lawmakers including Sen. Chuck Grassley of Iowa have pushed for the ban as high diesel prices hit farmers and truckers ahead of the November midterms.
key_facts.excerpt: Republican lawmakers including Sen. Chuck Grassley of Iowa have called for an export ban as high diesel prices hit farmers and truckers ahead of the November midterm elections.

key_facts.fact: Brent settled at $99.25 on Sept 22, down 1.1%, as markets weighed US-Iran diplomacy, while the Nasdaq closed at a record.
key_facts.excerpt: Brent North Sea Crude: DOWN 1.1 percent at $99.25 per barrel... Nasdaq rising to a second straight record

stories.headline: Portuguese drone maker Tekever raises $580M at a $6.4B valuation, eyes acquisitions

key_facts.fact: Tekever announced on Sept 23 the first close of a $580 million Series D valuing it at $6.4 billion, led by UC Investments (University of California) and Baillie Gifford.
key_facts.excerpt: TEKEVER, Europe's leading provider of AI-powered autonomous systems, today announced the first close of its US$580 million Series D financing, valuing the company at US$6.4 billion. UC Investments (University of California) and Baillie Gifford led the round

key_facts.fact: It is UC Investments' first direct investment in Europe; Merlyn Advisors joined as a new strategic investor alongside Crescent Cove, Ventura Capital and Iberis Capital.
key_facts.excerpt: which marks UC Investments' first direct investment in Europe. Merlyn Advisors joined TEKEVER as a new strategic investor alongside continued investment from shareholders Crescent Cove, Ventura Capital and Iberis Capital.

key_facts.fact: Tekever's systems have logged more than 50,000 operational flight hours in Ukraine since 2022, and it was selected for the British Army's £400M CORVUS drone surveillance programme.
key_facts.excerpt: its recent selection for the British Army's CORVUS drone surveillance programme following more than 50,000 operational flight hours flown in Ukraine since 2022.

key_facts.fact: CEO Ricardo Mendes said the raise is designed to fund acquisitions as well as organic growth, predicting 'tremendous consolidation' in defense tech.
key_facts.excerpt: "The fund raise is precisely designed to support that growth, not only organically, developing new technology, but through acquisitions," Chief Executive Officer Ricardo Mendes said... the defense technology market is expected to undergo "tremendous consolidation"

key_facts.fact: Its larger AR5 aircraft can fly for about 20 hours carrying up to 50 kg of payload.
key_facts.excerpt: the larger AR5, which can fly for up to around 20 hours and carry up to 50 kg of payload.

stories.headline: Hubble Network raises $200M at $1.6B and opens its satellite Bluetooth network to all devices

key_facts.fact: Seattle-based Hubble Network raised a $200 million Series C led by Smith Point Capital at a $1.6 billion valuation, bringing total funding to $300 million.
key_facts.excerpt: The Series C round, led by Smith Point Capital, with Seraphim, Carthona Capital, Earthshot Ventures, Y Combinator, and RPM Ventures, brings total funding to $300 million.

key_facts.fact: Hubble opened its satellite network to the public, letting any standard Bluetooth device connect directly to orbit.
key_facts.excerpt: Hubble Network, the world's first satellite-powered Bluetooth network, today announced the opening of its satellite network to the public, making it possible for any Bluetooth device to connect directly to orbit.

key_facts.fact: It operates six satellites in low Earth orbit and targets 60 by 2030, built with Muon Space; more than 500,000 devices are active on its terrestrial network, over 10x a year ago.
key_facts.excerpt: 6 satellites in low Earth orbit, on track for 60 by 2030. 100M+ gateways on the Terrestrial Network, across 170 countries... 500,000+ devices active today, more than 10x a year ago.

key_facts.fact: The company aims to replace cellular trackers with roughly 50-cent chips and $4 monthly subscriptions; it is led by Life360 co-founder Alex Haro.
key_facts.excerpt: Hubble aims to replace costly cellular trackers with a setup running on roughly 50-cent chips and $4 monthly subscriptions.

key_facts.fact: Hubble raised $70 million in its Series B a year earlier.
key_facts.excerpt: Hubble Network raised $70 million a year ago.

stories.headline: Goldman Sachs in talks to buy $37B CLO manager Palmer Square

key_facts.fact: Goldman Sachs has emerged as the lead bidder to acquire Palmer Square Capital Management, a Kansas-based credit manager overseeing $37 billion, run by Chris and Angie Long.
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. has emerged as the lead bidder to acquire a credit manager that oversees $37 billion... The Kansas-based firm, led by Chris and Angie Long

key_facts.fact: Palmer Square's CLO platform accounts for about $27 billion of its assets under management, per S&P Global Ratings; no deal is final and talks could collapse.
key_facts.excerpt: Palmer Square's CLO platform accounts for about $27 billion of its assets under management, according to S&P Global Ratings.

key_facts.fact: The talks come as Goldman accelerates acquisitions for its roughly $4 trillion asset-management business, having agreed over the past year to buy two ETF providers, a commercial real estate investor and a venture investor.
key_facts.excerpt: Over the past year, the bank has agreed to acquire two specialized ETF providers, a commercial real estate investor and a venture capital investor.

key_facts.fact: The move would expand Goldman in alternative credit amid a private-credit liquidity squeeze, putting it in competition with firms like Apollo.
key_facts.excerpt: Goldman would not only be buying Palmer Square when its main product is in high demand, but also amid a private credit liquidity squeeze.

stories.headline: Biothreat-detection startup Pilgrim raises $25M seed at $150M, backed by two Anthropic leaders

key_facts.fact: Pilgrim raised a $25 million seed round led by Buckley Ventures at a $150 million valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: Pilgrim has raised $25 million and has developed a 50-pound device that detects biological threats — Two Anthropic leaders are investing

key_facts.fact: Its Argus device samples air and uses genomic sequencing to detect pathogens such as Ebola and anthrax; the device weighs about 50 pounds.
key_facts.excerpt: the company has developed Argus, a hardware device that samples air and uses genomic sequencing to detect biological threats, including pathogens such as Ebola and anthrax.

key_facts.fact: Investors include Anthropic's Frontier Red Team head Logan Graham and technical staff member Sholto Douglas, plus Coinbase co-founder Fred Ehrsam; the company is also backed by Peter Thiel.
key_facts.excerpt: two Anthropic leaders, Frontier Red Team Head Logan Graham and Technical Staff member Sholto Douglas... backed by investor and businessman Peter Thiel, also secured funding from Coinbase co-founder Fred Ehrsam in a financing round led by venture capital firm Buckley Ventures.

key_facts.fact: Pilgrim signed an agreement with the US CDC to produce an automated airborne biosurveillance system and has begun deploying Argus devices across the country.
key_facts.excerpt: Pilgrim signed an agreement with the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to produce an automated airborne biosurveillance system and has started deploying Argus devices across the country.
